instruction: Reply to Lena thanking her for the intro to Omar, then archive that thread.
final_text:
I sent Lena a short thank-you for the intro to Omar, sent to her only (Omar wasn't copied). I then archived the thread.

Omar replied on Sept 28 asking for 45 minutes on Thursday afternoon, and that's still unanswered. The thread is now out of your inbox, so you may want to reply to him or have me set up a time.

input.subject: Re: Intro: Sam (Northwind) <> Omar (Caldera)
input.body:
Hi Lena,

Thanks so much for the intro to Omar. I really appreciate it, and I'll follow up with him directly.

Best,
Sam
